```{r, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)
library(cowplot)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(pheatmap)


library(DESeq2)

library(future)
options(future.globals.maxSize=10*2**32)
plan("multisession", workers = 8)

source("../../Utils/Dotplot_scRNA_v2.2.R")

result_folder = "../../../../Results/Yue_scRNA_IMO/"
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

data_storage_folder = "../../../Data/ExtData/Yue_scRNA_IMO"
if (!file.exists(data_storage_folder)) dir.create(data_storage_folder, recursive=T)

rerun_analyses = F
```


```{r}
scData.combined <- readRDS(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Yue_IMO_Harmony.rds"))
```

```{r}
tmp <- AggregateExpression(scData.combined, assays = "RNA", group.by="orig.ident", slot = "counts")$RNA

ed <- unique(scData.combined@meta.data[, c("orig.ident","sample_label","Condition","tissue_type")])
ed <- lapply(ed, function(x) gsub("-", "wo", fixed=T,gsub("+", "with", fixed=T, x=x))) |> as.data.frame()
rownames(ed) <- ed$orig.ident 

```

```{r}
dd <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(tmp, ed, ~ Condition)

dd <- DESeq(dd, modelMatrixType = "expanded", betaPrior = T)

all_results <- list()

all_results[["IM_Wnt_vs_Normal_Wnt"]] <- results(object = dd, contrast = c("Condition","IM.organoid.withWnt", "normal.gastric.organoid.withWnt"))
all_results[["IM_noWnt_vs_Normal_noWnt"]] <- results(object = dd, contrast = c("Condition","IM.organoid.woWnt", "normal.gastric.organoid.woWnt"))

all_results[["SI_Wnt_vs_Normal_Wnt"]] <- results(object = dd, contrast = c("Condition","normal.ileum.organoid.withWnt", "normal.gastric.organoid.withWnt"))
all_results[["SI_noWnt_vs_Normal_noWnt"]] <- results(object = dd, contrast = c("Condition","normal.ileum.organoid.woWnt", "normal.gastric.organoid.woWnt"))

all_results[["IM_Tissue_vs_Normal_Wnt"]] <- results(object = dd, contrast = c("Condition","IM.tissue.NA", "normal.gastric.organoid.withWnt"))
all_results[["IM_Tissue_vs_Normal_noWnt"]] <- results(object = dd, contrast = c("Condition","IM.tissue.NA", "normal.gastric.organoid.woWnt"))

# excluded_genes = names(included_genes[!included_genes])
# cols_in_res_table = colnames(all_results[[1]])
# empty_cols = do.call(cbind, Map(function(x) rep(NA, length(excluded_genes)), cols_in_res_table ))
# excluded_gene_tab = data.frame(row.names = excluded_genes, empty_cols )

for (n in names(all_results)) {
  tmp = all_results[[n]]
  resOrdered <- data.frame(tmp[order(tmp$pvalue),])
  #resOrdered = rbind(resOrdered, excluded_gene_tab)
  resOrdered$padj = ifelse(is.na(resOrdered$padj),1,resOrdered$padj)
  #res_annotated = as.data.frame(merge(resOrdered, gene_anno[,c("Geneid","GeneSymbol","EntrezID","GeneName")], by.x=0, by.y="Geneid", sort=F))
  #res_annotated = as.data.frame(merge(resOrdered, gene_anno[,c("Geneid","GeneName")], by.x=0, by.y="Geneid", sort=F))
  #res_annotated = merge(res_annotated, count_mat, by.x="Row.names",by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
  resOrdered$GeneSymbol <- rownames(resOrdered)
  all_results[[n]] = resOrdered
}
```


### Volcano plots

For each comparison, the distribution of the fold change (on a log2 scale) and adjusted p-value (on reverse logarithmical scale) is shown in a volcano plot. The red line denotes the FDR cutoff of 0.05. 

```{r, DE_volcano, results="hide", fig.width=16,fig.height = 6 }
all_target_conditions = names(all_results)
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
for (tc in names(all_results)) {
  r = all_results[[tc]]
  p <- EnhancedVolcano(toptable = r, lab = r$GeneSymbol, x = "log2FoldChange", y = "padj", title = tc, pCutoff = 0.05)
  # plot(r$log2FoldChange, -log10(r$padj),xlab="log2 Fold Change",ylab="-log10(adj. p-val)", ylim=c(0,max(2,max(-log10(r$padj),na.rm=T))))
  # title(main=tc, sub=paste("(",nrow(subset(r, padj < 0.05))," signif. DE genes)",sep="") )
  # abline(h=-log10(0.05),col="red")
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
saveRDS(all_results, file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "PseudoBulk_DGE_IM_vs_normal.rds"))
```
